what_happened: Task 589's own archived completion summary (recovered via git show, since its specs/ dir is no longer in the live tree) already names the exact lint ('lint-test-root-resolution.sh', modeled on lint-test-harness-adoption.sh) and the sanctioned-vs-forbidden discriminator (git-first-guarded fallback = sanctioned; unconditional fixed-depth = forbidden), removing most of the open-question burden from this research pass.

Re-running task 589's own measurement method against the current tree found three additional, currently-live instances of the forbidden unconditional-walk-up shape that neither task 589 nor this dispatch's own citation named: test-state-write-spill-names.sh:74, test-source-store-path-lib.sh:136, and test-orchestrate-context-growth.sh:308,313-314. Two of the three silently mask a real-state-pollution/real-specs-leak guard into a false PASS when run from the deployed invocation path -- confirmed by direct cd-chain execution from both paths, not merely inferred. Recommend the plan fix these three as part of landing the lint so it can launch at zero violations.
